title: idev shared definitions
description: Types more than one contract needs. Referenced by $ref so a change lands in one place; the kind and agent enums are generated from registry/kinds.yaml and live in kinds.schema.json.

ulid.description: A ULID: 26 Crockford base32 characters, timestamp first so ids sort chronologically.

digest.description: A prefixed sha256, so a bare hex value can never be mistaken for another algorithm's.

featureKey.description: A ticket slug. '-' means the round is not bound to a ticket, which the weekly audit counts.

stepStatus.description: The terminal step values. UNPROVEN is an honest outcome, not a failure: it means no runner exists for that dimension.

repoRelativePath.description: A path inside the repository. Absolute paths and escapes are refused so a lease boundary can be checked by string comparison.

pathGlob.description: A repo-relative glob. '**' crosses separators; '*' and '?' do not.

evidence.description: Where to look to see that this is true. A PASS with no evidence does not count.

fencing_token.description: Monotonic per feature. A late report from a superseded holder carries the old value.

baselineRef.description: Which baseline revision the work was done against. Compared with the recomputed value at acceptance, which is how sign-then-edit is caught.

errorPayload.description: The structured half of an MCP or HTTP error. `stop` means the conductor must halt rather than retry.
